messages.content: You write one standalone Python program for a local DOCX editing task. Return only Python source, with no explanation. Read input.docx and write output.docx in the current directory. You may use the Python standard library, python-docx 1.2.0 and lxml 6.1.3. Do not use network access, subprocesses, other files, or external services. The input contains existing comments and pending tracked changes. Preserve all existing review content, authors, dates, formatting, relationships and other document content. Do not accept or reject existing changes. If you cannot perform the task, raise a clear exception. Do not use an integrity checker.

In input.docx replace the unique ordinary-text marker TABLEBEFORE with TABLEAFTER exactly once. It is in the first table, second row, second column. Preserve the cell and table structure, all formatting, and any pending insertions or deletions beside that marker. Change nothing else. The replacement may be untracked. If you create tracked text, use Evidence Editor as its author and preserve all earlier changes. Save the result as output.docx.
